chain_words.nuance: has the power or means to do something
able to do something well when needed
good at something through training or practice
exceptionally good, with a natural gift

explanation: These words all describe ability, from simply being able to do something up to having an exceptional natural gift for it.

usage_notes.difference: 'Able' only says that someone can do something; 'skilled' means they have developed the ability through training or practice.
